title: Task (entity)
description: A REQUEST — something to be carried out; the mutable belief while in flight. Resolution is its CONVERSION into an Event fact (retire the entity, the fact carries the memory); a Task never records that anything happened, so it carries no terminal stamp. Storage merges provider metadata FLAT into entity.data (single JSON column, gcal event.schema.json precedent): source (natural-key half), etag (source updatedAt — the runtime no-op field; a Task deliberately carries NO source_status — its lifecycle ends in conversion, not stamping), tada_source (provenance passthrough).

source_id.description: Native id in the source system — half of the natural key (source, source_id).

status.description: In-flight only — there is no completed/cancelled here: those are conversions, not states.

start_at.description: The slot the request targets (ISO 8601 UTC). Absent/null = floating — absence IS the state.

recurrence_of.description: NATIVE uid of the Recurrence this occurrence materialized from; absent on non-series items (dangling-proof native ref). Deliberately NOT 'recurrence_id' — in iCalendar that name means the RECURRENCE-ID property (which instance was modified), different semantics.
